reviews.title: Upgrade is awful
reviews.text: Before the upgrade it was really good but even my 5 year old doesn’t like it anymore. Changing the voice was a bad choice too.

reviews.title: Santas Voice Box Operation…?!?
reviews.text: Since when did Santa change his voice?? Our toddler realises it’s a new voice (Version 5) and “it isn’t Santa” (or at least the one they know)! The app should either revert back to the old voice (saving children from getting upset, who knew the voice) or at least give you a choice of both old and new voice! Obviously autistic children, or those who’ve heard Santa over the last few years, weren’t thought about when they changed his voice….!! 😞

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.text: Don’t waste your money and if you do Apple/Santa app will not give it back even if you tell them the app was dysfunctional.  It’s only a few dollars but, it’s irritating to pay for a product and not have it work and not get my money back. We tried having it call my son (6 years old) a few times but, it was just silent on the other side. Near caused an issue with my son who believes. So don’t bother.

reviews.title: Dark UX
reviews.text:
Doesn’t tell you you need to register to use until AFTER you pay. Gives you the impression that you can use it without registering your email when you first open the app.

Main reason for negative review is that on Xmas even the app is stuck loading! I’ve paid money and it won’t even work. Very frustrating.
